data.title: env-inherit trailing-wildcard suffixes (RITE_*)
data.description: New validator src/env_inherit.rs lets --env-inherit accept a single trailing wildcard like RITE_* to inherit a namespace. Review focus: (1) grammar bans leading *_TOKEN, embedded RITE_*_TOKEN, multiple, unanchored AWS*, trivial _* wildcards; requires concrete prefix ending in _; (2) malformed patterns hard-fail, no silent skip; (3) explicit --env wins over inherited (resolve skips already-set keys) since child shells resolve duplicate keys last-wins; (4) matched var NAMES logged to stderr, never values. Wiring in src/main.rs, help in src/cli.rs.

data.body: LOW (robustness): std::env::vars() panics if any name/value in the caller's env is not valid UTF-8. With --env-inherit set, a single non-UTF8 var anywhere in the caller env aborts 'vessel spawn' even when the pattern would not match that var. Self-inflicted only (caller's own process), no cross-privilege impact, but vars_os() + lossy/skip handling would avoid the cliff.

LOW (defense-in-depth): only all-underscore prefixes are rejected as trivial, so a 1-char namespace like 'A_*' passes and matches every A_-prefixed var. Acceptable — it stays anchored to a concrete caller-named namespace and only touches the caller's own env — but a minimum prefix length would tighten accidental over-broad selection. Non-blocking.

data.reason: Security review passed. Wildcard grammar correctly blocks credential-harvesting shapes (*_TOKEN, RITE_*_TOKEN, AWS*, _*, *); trailing-prefix-only means no suffix/role selection is possible. Reads caller's own env only (no daemon secret harvesting), explicit --env precedence enforced, dedup + hard-fail on malformed + names-only audit log. No injection (splitn env parse, direct setenv, no shell). 2 non-blocking LOW notes.
